fileHash: archive:ultimate-ultimate-art-bell-collection:1995-12-07 - Coast to Coast AM with Art Bell - Remote Viewing - Maj. Ed Dames (first appearance).mp3

fileHash: archive:ultimate-ultimate-art-bell-collection:1996-11-14 - Coast to Coast AM with Art Bell - Courtney Brown - Remote Viewing the Hale-Bopp Anomaly.mp3

source.title: Exposing PseudoAstronomy — Chuck Shramek (Stuart Robbins); see also Wikipedia, Comet Hale–Bopp § UFO claims
